ops.body:
Root's final delta review of PR #3 head 921e0d4 (2026-09-30, report `recovery-20260930/cookiesync-m8-root-review.md`, bus #280/#283) returned CHANGES_REQUESTED on M8 only: `internal/bridge/crashpad_linux.go` adopted any /proc process whose argv carried `--database=<dataDir>/Crashpad` and pidfd-signaled it; the pidfd pins identity, not creation ownership, and `TestServesCrashpadDatabase` / `TestHandlerTrackerReapsOnlyItsSessionsHandlers` positively asserted that an arbitrary `/bin/sh` with the matching argument is adopted and killed. M7 (daemonkit v0.32.2 + real Program) was accepted.

Contract posted (bus #292) and APPROVED by root (bus #298) with additions:
1. Each Linux bridge launch generates a 16-byte crypto/rand nonce exported only through the environment as `COOKIESYNC_BRIDGE_LAUNCH=<nonce>`, never argv; crashpad's double-fork `execv` inherits the browser environ so the real handler carries it.
2. Adoption requires the session `--database=` argv match AND the exact nonce in `/proc/<pid>/environ` AND the crash-handler executable role (`/proc/<pid>/exe` basename `chrome_crashpad_handler`; synthetic doubles may model the role by exec'ing a copied `/bin/sh` under that name). The pidfd is opened before the evidence read (a pid reused between read and open would pin the wrong process; the reverse only pins a dead one). PID/PPID/PGID/SID/start time/full cmdline/exe are recorded with the evidence before any signal.
3. A matching candidate without the nonce, with unreadable environ, or with the wrong executable role is preserved, never signaled; Close reaps owned handlers only and returns a cleanup refusal naming each preserved pid, database and reason. No name/tag/group/UID sweep; Darwin bytes unchanged.
4. The nonce is never serialized, logged, returned (bridge_open JSON), persisted (saved bridge record) or baked into images.
5. Tests invert the unrelated expectation (unowned doubles survive Close and are named in the refusal; nonce-carrying handler-role doubles get TERM/KILL); the real-Chrome smoke keeps its strict pre/post-Close gate and must prove actual nonce inheritance plus zero survivors. If CI shows the handler does not inherit the environment: return a PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER ancestry plan to root before any change, never a weaker gate.
6. Built in an isolated worktree by a fable lane; lands on PR #3 as one commit; final root delta review before merge.
